signal: Endor Labs acquired Autonomous Plane in February 2026 and introduced AURI, security intelligence for agentic software development, in March, expanding into the SAST budget.

email.subject1: a signal play for Endor Labs
email.body1:
Andrew, saw Endor Labs acquired Autonomous Plane and launched AURI, security intelligence for agentic software development, this year.

Expanding into new budgets that fast usually means more AppSec accounts in play than BD can touch before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Endor off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Andrew, quick follow-up for Endor Labs.

As AURI and the acquisition open the SAST segment, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to convert it, so the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Endor needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Andrew, last bit of proof for Endor Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other AppSec startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Andrew, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding BD headcount is not a priority while you integrate the acquisition and launch AURI, no problem at all. That stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an AppSec motion? I will tailor it to Endor either way.
